# Turbo Picard 0.1.13

Native implementations of selected Picard 3.4.0 commands, not the entire upstream suite.

- [Picard workflows. Native speed.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/)
- [MarkDuplicates: slow runs and memory failures](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/solutions/markduplicates-memory/)
- [BAM to FASTQ, without the guesswork](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/solutions/bam-to-fastq/)
- [Sequencing QC without the repeated work](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/solutions/sequencing-qc/)
- [BAM sorting that fits your workflow](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/solutions/bam-sorting/)
- [Find your command. Know the boundary.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/commands/)
- [Prove the switch on your data.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/evaluate/)
- [One package. A familiar command.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/install/)
- [Choose by workflow. Not by the biggest number.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/compare/)
- [Evidence you can inspect.](https://turbo-picard.readthedocs.io/en/latest/evidence/)

## Machine interface

`turbo-picard capabilities --json --command MarkDuplicates`
`turbo-picard trial --json MarkDuplicates I=input.bam O=turbo.bam M=turbo.txt`
Inspection is not input validation. Prefer argv arrays and shell=False.
Set TURBO_PICARD_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 to prohibit upstream fallback.
PyPI installs a picard shim as well: isolate the environment.
Benchmarks describe saved fixtures, not universal production speedups.
